title: When your setup looks good, but the market has other plans......
author: KimOnMacro
selftext:
It's easy to say news is "already priced in" and focus on your technicals (I used to do that for years). But sometimes, what's happening outside your chart can work directly against your setup that you can be blind to. 

So after that, I started searching up news constantly while trading, and it definitely increased the accuracy of my own trades and revealed losses that should be cut faster. 

**Quick examples:**

**1. EURUSD:** You're buying a breakout, but US jobs data comes in much stronger than expected, EURUSD falls.

**2. Oil:** You're buying a breakout, but Trump announces a ceasefire that eases fears of oil supply disruptions, oil falls.

**3. Gold:** You're buying gold at support, but news emerges that a central bank is selling part of its gold reserves.

**4. Nasdaq:** You're buying a breakout, but the Fed signals rates could stay higher for longer, putting pressure on tech stocks.  


I thought this whole manual process can be much faster and easier with AI so I built Echelon.   
You can explore the potential impact of market news and click any candle to see the news and cross market flows timestamped at that time.  


**Echelon isn't about being a crystal ball or replacing your technicals. It will do none of that.**   
**But, it will give you more context to help spot better setups and avoid potential traps.**

[https://echelonedgeai.com/](https://echelonedgeai.com/)
